He argues that despite its grievous sins, the inhabitants of Jerusalem should be the first to receive the gospel of repentance and forgiveness, demonstrating God’s compassionate desire to save the most lost among us. Through this, Bunyan emphasizes the transformative power of grace and the importance of sharing this message with all who are in need of redemption, regardless of their past transgressions.
